mutants.description: Delta-CoVaR subtracts crisis CoVaR from median CoVaR, reversing the sign of systemic contribution.
compute_mes computes the unconditional mean institutional return instead of conditioning on market crisis.
compute_srisk omits the non-negative max(0, CS) clamp, allowing capital surplus to report negative SRISK.
compute_network_clearing executes only one iteration of payment updates, missing multi-round default cascades.
compute_lrmes sets LRMES directly equal to market beta, ignoring exponential crisis drop scaling.
